title: Agent resolved
description: What an agent gets from the app that runs it: who it works for, its policies, MCP servers, notify targets, channels and workspaces. The app decides this each time the agent runs.

principal.description: Who the agent works for. Its credentials are theirs. Missing when it works for no one.

servers.description: The MCP servers the agent can use.

name.description: The name the agent's tools use for the server.

server.description: The server's name: its owner's name for it, or the name the app starts it by.

owner.description: Who keeps the server: its owner, or `deployment` for one the app starts with. Absent when the app gives no owner.

tools.description: The names of the tools the server offers now. Empty when the server is down or hasn't listed its tools yet.

policy.description: The app's policies for the agent, in the same format as a policy file. Each tool call is checked against all of them.

policies.description: Named policies the agent's definition can use, by name.

defaults.description: Settings the agent gets where its definition doesn't set them, such as model.

notify.description: The notify targets the agent can send to.

name.description: The name the agent's definition uses for the target.

target.description: The target's name in the app. Missing when the app sends the notices itself.

channels.description: The workspace each channel posts the agent's notices in, by channel name.

workspaces.description: Other agents' workspaces the agent can mount, by agent ID.
